description.en: The ID of the data entry.

description.zh: 描述信息，长度不超过180个字符
description.en: The description of the data entry. The description cannot exceed 180 characters in length.

description.zh: 数据条目超时时间，格式为**yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）**
description.en: The time in UTC when the data entry expires. The time is in the **yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ** format.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-dataset-item --dataset-id a25a6589b2584ff490e891cc00000000 --dataset-item-id 50450000 --expired-time 2022-09-22T12:00:00Z --description description --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
